surface-paper.purpose: Tiles, cards, and framed utility panels.

accent-green.purpose: Sparse selected state and status accent.

accent-blue.purpose: Cool technical accent, especially in Playground.

display.purpose: Brand moments and compact identity text only.

body.purpose: Portfolio prose, project descriptions, metadata, and utility text.

motion.reducedMotion: Transitions should disable or simplify under prefers-reduced-motion.

playgroundGallery.purpose: Visual archive surface with a two-row desktop board.
rules: Show the full desktop gallery without vertical scroll.
Use project-specific composition classes for unusual image whitespace.
Keep individual tiles at 8px radius inside the larger shell.

chromeControls.purpose: Launchpad, contact, and upload controls that may use the chrome surface token.
rules: Gloss must map to a named material token.
Do not copy chrome gradients into arbitrary cards.

dont: Generic SaaS landing-page metrics and gradients.
Over-glossy glass UI as default identity.
Motion, sound, or haptics as required comprehension.
